description: Source code implementing IRQ handling and simulation models for Zephyr OS on POSIX, including interrupt vector management, IRQ control, and WFE/SEV ARM instruction modeling.

methods.name: vector_to_irq
methods.description: Handles dispatching of IRQs, calling the registered handler or ignoring if sniffer indicates.

methods.name: posix_irq_handler
methods.description: Main IRQ handler that processes highest priority IRQs, manages nested IRQs, and performs thread switching if needed.

methods.name: posix_irq_handler_im_from_sw
methods.description: Handles software-triggered IRQs, invoking posix_irq_handler if higher priority IRQs are pending.

methods.name: posix_irq_lock
methods.description: Disables interrupts and returns a lock key.

methods.name: posix_irq_unlock
methods.description: Re-enables interrupts using the provided lock key.

methods.name: posix_irq_is_enabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific IRQ line is enabled.

methods.name: posix_get_current_irq
methods.description: Returns the currently running IRQ number.

methods.name: posix_isr_declare
methods.description: Configures a static interrupt with handler, parameters, and flags.

methods.name: posix_irq_priority_set
methods.description: Sets the priority of an IRQ.

methods.name: posix_irq_offload
methods.description: Runs a function in interrupt context via IRQ offload.

methods.name: nrfbsim_WFE_model
methods.description: Models the WFE ARM instruction, setting a flag and halting CPU if needed.

methods.name: nrfbsim_SEV_model
methods.description: Models the SEV ARM instruction, setting a flag to wake CPU.
